newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa orders three Canadair jets.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa orders three Canadair jets.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Friday it had ordered three Canadair Regional Jet aircraft for delivery in March 1997 and early 1998 from Canada's Bombardier Inc.
Lufthansa said in a press release that the addition of the craft would bring its Canadair Jet fleet to 31 planes.
Lufthansa said the new jets would replace three Fokker 50 planes, which would be handed on to German regional airline Contact Air, a partner of Lufthansa, at the beginning of next year.
The airline also said it held options for three further Canadair jets from Bombardier.
Lufthansa said since the introduction of Canadair Jets in 1992 it had successfully built up non-stop connections between less frequented German destinations and European cities.

The employment of smaller jets had made shorter flights economical, the airline said, adding that more than three million passengers had flown with its Canadair Jet fleet to 10 German and 41 European destinations.
